description: This file defines the ApplyPatchTool class, a tool for applying patches to files within a project. It includes methods for parsing patches, handling file creation, deletion, updates, and moving files, with user approval and diff visualization features.

classes.name: ApplyPatchTool
classes.description: A class extending BaseTool to handle applying patches to files, including creating, updating, deleting, and moving files with user approval and diff visualization.

methods.name: parseLegacy
methods.description: Parses legacy parameters to extract the patch string.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main method to parse and apply the patch, handling each file change accordingly.

methods.name: handleAddFile
methods.description: Handles creation of new files based on patch data, with user approval.

methods.name: handleDeleteFile
methods.description: Handles deletion of files based on patch data, with user approval.

methods.name: handleUpdateFile
methods.description: Handles updating or moving files based on patch data, with user approval.

methods.name: handlePartial
methods.description: Provides a preview of the patch for user confirmation.
